# The Contracting Preacher

> Dr. McKnight — The Contracting Preacher — helps small businesses nationwide win federal government contracts. SAM.gov registration, bid writing, 8(a) certification, proposal preparation, funding readiness, and more. Based in Columbia, South Carolina, serving businesses nationwide with 15 offices across the country.

## Services

- SAM.gov Registration & Renewal — Starting at $497
- Bid & Proposal Writing — Starting at $1,497
- SBA 8(a) Certification — Starting at $2,497
- HUBZone Certification — Starting at $1,997
- WOSB/EDWOSB Certification — Starting at $1,497
- SDVOSB/VOSB Certification — Starting at $1,497

## Business Funding + Contracting AI Command Center

A funding-ready business data room at /command-center that lets AI search grants, contracts,
investors, sponsors, loans, accelerators, and partnerships, then score fit, draft applications,
and track every deadline. Includes an AI opportunity-scoring engine (9 weighted factors, 100-point
scale), a 24-folder master data room, workflow and approval gates, and a South Carolina funding
profile.

## South Carolina Government Contracting Resource Vault

A searchable database at /south-carolina-contracting-resources covering every South Carolina
government buyer: all 46 counties, 271 municipalities, state agencies, school districts,
universities, transportation authorities, utilities, housing authorities, and federal
installations — with bid portals, registration links, and certification requirements.

## AI Tools On This Site

- AI Contracting Assistant (/agent) — plain-language search across contracts, grants, SBIR/STTR, and award history
- Federal Opportunity Finder (/opportunities) — unified search of SAM.gov, Grants.gov, USAspending, SBIR.gov, and Federal Register
- Federal Funding Intelligence (/intelligence) — live data source directory with SAM.gov, Simpler.Grants.gov, USAspending, CourtListener case law search, and Data.gov dataset catalog

## Approach

- Disciplined, honest proposal guidance — bids are only recommended where the
  client has a genuine, realistically-assessed competitive advantage
- Hands-on, personalized support rather than templated packages
- Compliance-first process for every registration, certification, and proposal
- Nationwide service across all 50 states
